correctness.rationale: For any initial letter a, non-nesting injects minimal unique factors into a-starts. For each factor av of length >=2, repeat of suffix v supplies an alternative start, whose predecessor differs from a by uniqueness of av; charges are distinct since coincident starts imply prefix-comparable factors. Singleton case holds for n>=2. For each de Bruijn cycle every order-r factor occurs once and each shorter factor at least twice, attaining the sum. Independent exhaustive checker passed 80,825 words and ten explicit de Bruijn cycles.

The 2011 full text remains a priority risk.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Prior non-nesting implies M_a <= n_a but not the essential second inequality M_a <= n-n_a. Linear suffix-array algorithms do not imply it without additional combinatorial reasoning.
